title: Square lattice of Salim Chishti’s tomb (Fatehpur Sikri)
subtitle: Salim Chishti’s tomb, Fatehpur Sikri, lower pattern

given.O: The centre of a small square.
given.A: The midpoint of its right-hand side.

construction.note: The finished design was read from Wichmann’s data206/SM3 drawing. Its polygon edges already coincide; the ochre stroke is not a gap between inset tiles. Half the small-square side gives the unit. Two radii and a unit-square diagonal give the half-side 2 + square root of two; four diagonals then close the pentagons and hexagons. The drawing gives no steps; we devised the construction.
construction.changes: The compass steps, their order and the named points are ours. The shared polygon boundaries follow the plain drawing; no band expansion is applied. The palette is illustrative; no photograph was checked. The lower pattern is the one identified by the source.

credits.source: Tiling Search, data206/SM3: Salim Chishti’s tomb, Fatehpur Sikri, lower pattern
credits.creator: Brian Wichmann
credits.note: Read from his finished drawing, not construction instructions. His reference is E. W. Smith, The Moghul Architecture of Fathpur-Sikri (1896), part II, plate XXVIII, figure 4, Salim Chishti’s tomb, Fatehpur Sikri, India (1581). This is data206/SM3, distinct from the related data205/SM3 cited on the IRAN16 page.

steps.text: Draw a horizontal straight line through O and A. Draw a circle with centre O through A.

Draw a vertical line through O. The two lines cross the circle at A, B, C and D. Draw a vertical line through each of A and B. Draw a horizontal line through each of C and D. The upper-right corner is E. Draw a straight line through O and E. Draw a straight line through A and C.
steps.textWithoutHelpers: Draw a vertical line through O. The two lines cross the circle at A, B, C and D. Draw a vertical line through each of A and B. Draw a horizontal line through each of C and D. The upper-right corner is E. Draw a straight line through O and E.

steps.text: Draw a circle with centre A through O. It crosses the horizontal line at F, beyond A. Draw a circle with centre F and radius OE. It crosses the horizontal line at G, to the right.

Draw a circle with centre O through G. It crosses the horizontal and vertical lines at T1 to T4. Draw a vertical line through each of T1 and T3. Draw a horizontal line through each of T2 and T4. They make a square with corners K1, K2, K3 and K4.
Draw a line through T1 parallel to line AC. Turn it round O by 90°, three times.
Join K1, K2, K3 and K4 to mark the tile that repeats.

ink.text: Ink the lines picked out in orange. They close the square, the four pentagons and the four hexagons.

pattern.text: Put copies of the square tile side by side.
